realm.name: AIHubAccess
realm.description: Required role to access AI-Hub. Users without this role are denied at login.

realm.name: AIHubSysAdmin
realm.description: System administrator access to infrastructure tools (Dagster, SeaweedFS, Attu, etc.)

realm.name: AIHubFederatedUser
realm.description: Granted on every sign-in through an external identity provider. Users with this role can neither sign in with a password nor reset one, so the identity provider's MFA and account state always apply.
